purpose: Recorded candidates for balancing temperature-data, reference edge-energy-flux and projection-aware transient-energy losses in the fixed-hydrodynamics P418 regional operator.

physical_parameter_status.statement: These are neural-network optimisation settings. They do not change pebble geometry, helium or ceramic properties, heating, boundary conditions, time histories or OpenFOAM data.

primary_source.paper: Multi-Objective Loss Balancing for Physics-Informed Deep Learning
primary_source.authors: Rafael Bischof and Michael A. Kraus
primary_source.journal: Computer Methods in Applied Mechanics and Engineering 439 (2025) 117914

formal_candidates.source: Registered fixed-weight baseline already used by the P418 fixed-hydrodynamics operator.
Bischof and Kraus, arXiv:2110.09813, table VIII, Burgers setting.
Bischof and Kraus, arXiv:2110.09813, table VIII, Kirchhoff setting.
Bischof and Kraus, arXiv:2110.09813, table VIII, Helmholtz setting.

selection_protocol.checkpoint_selection: Use the same unweighted validation score for every candidate: the arithmetic mean of the three dimensionless validation loss groups.
selection_protocol.method_selection: Select the candidate on validation curves only, with identical architecture, split and random seed.
selection_protocol.independent_test: Read the strict test curves once after the candidate and checkpoint are fixed.
selection_protocol.claim_limit: Published settings are candidates for this pebble-bed problem; superiority is not claimed before the validation-only comparison is complete.
